backend_config.reply_function: deterministic fallback-severity echo, identical to the compiler harness mock (pinned by tests)

config.call_protocol: one live call per distinct signature batch; repeats would be result-cache hits (the Section 5.7.1 protocol)

provenance.gold_labels: planted at batch generation from an explicit keyword rubric (gold_rubric below): synthetic ground truth on synthetic signatures, not human annotation of real logs
provenance.rule_fallback: the classify step's deterministic fallback (paper_real_llm_compiler_test.fallback_severity, imported -- identical function), used by the pipeline whenever a reply line does not parse
provenance.prompt: the pipeline's CLASSIFY_PROMPT verbatim (imported from paper_real_llm_compiler_test): identical prompt to the Section 5.7.1 classify step; prompt_sha256 recorded per call
provenance.parser: same per-index regex as parse_classification (mirror pinned by tests); each signature's claim_source records whether its severity came from the model reply ('model') or the fallback rule ('rule_fallback')
provenance.model_reply: raw reply text recorded verbatim per call with sha256; stop_reason from the gateway (end_turn vs max_tokens)
provenance.latency: measured per call (real) / accounted constant 80 ms (mock)
provenance.draw_sequence: seeded truncated-Zipf draws (same weight formula as the microbenchmark suite) over the fixed task population; batches are per-rank deterministic and sorted

notes: all_pass gates only the measurability preconditions (one call per distinct batch, raw replies and gold labels recorded, no reply bound at the token ceiling, at least one model claim parsed); agreement rates are reported measurements -- no accuracy threshold is claimed or gated.

Gold labels are a planted keyword rubric on synthetic signatures (recorded verbatim in provenance), not human annotation of real logs; agreement-vs-gold is a rubric-following diagnostic, not a deployment-quality claim.

If replies report stop_reason=max_tokens, those replies' classifications are fallback-derived -- exactly the Section 5.7.1 failure mode; raise --max-tokens and rerun before reading the agreement rates as model quality.

The reply parser accepts the classify step's documented '<index>: <severity>' line format (same regex as the pipeline's fallback-filling parse); replies that do not follow it are counted as unparsed, with each missing classification attributed to the fallback rule.
Single gateway, one model alias, one seed, sequential, no streaming; multi-model, multi-seed and real-deployment behavior remain untested.
